precedence.rule: Within the Y6M1.4 / L3T2M24 lesson scope, this override supersedes any generic Year 6/L3 equivalent-curriculum alias rule that would present, catalogue or grant this lesson through the normal Year 6 stream.
doesNotChange: The internal canonical lessonId remains Y6M1.4.
Generic Year 6/L3 equivalence remains valid for other lessons unless separately overridden.
L3/11+ resources and legitimate L3 access remain preserved.

ownerRequirement.statement: L3T2M24 Linear Sequences is an L3 (11+) lesson only. It must not appear anywhere in the normal Year 6 stream and must not be granted merely because a student is a normal Year 6 Maths student.

findings: Canonical lesson:Y6M1.4 still exposed displayIds.maths-year6=Y6T2M8 even though curriculum:MATHS_L3 was the only curriculum list containing the lesson.
Prepared global state materialised Y6M1.4 into both maths-year6 and maths-level3.
Prepared lesson scope lesson:Y6M1.4 still contained the old ScreenPal cOVTQxn3IMa after the canonical record had already been changed to cOQvDXnxxvX.
A canonical-only video write was therefore insufficient because the live browser consumes prepared read models.

actions: Removed displayIds.maths-year6 from canonical lesson:Y6M1.4 while preserving maths-level3=L3T2M24.
Published a new immutable prepared global version with Y6M1.4 removed from maths-year6 and retained only in maths-level3.
Refreshed only access snapshots potentially affected by normal Year 6 membership/full-library/history/upsell state.
Published a new immutable prepared lesson version with the normal video variant removed and the elevenPlus video pointed to cOQvDXnxxvX.
Read-back verified that the old ScreenPal ID cOVTQxn3IMa and the normal Year 6 alias are absent from current prepared lesson state.

permanentInvariants: Never infer normal-Year-6 eligibility for Y6M1.4 from the internal canonical lessonId alone.
Any catalogue/global read-model rebuild must keep Y6M1.4 out of maths-year6 and keep L3T2M24 in maths-level3.
Any lesson-detail rebuild must publish only the elevenPlus video variant for this lesson and must not recreate a normal variant.
The active L3T2M24 lesson video is ScreenPal cOQvDXnxxvX; cOVTQxn3IMa is obsolete for this lesson.
Do not remove or downgrade legitimate L3/11+ access while enforcing the normal-Year-6 exclusion.
Production recovery remains forward-only; never rollback or revert later valid Portal changes to enforce this rule.

postRepairBrowserEvidence.ownerObservation: After the L3-only canonical/prepared repair, the owner still sees a Lessons card on the Maths landing page.
doNotConflateWith: permission to restore normal Year 6 membership for Y6M1.4
postRepairBrowserEvidence.nextInvestigationBoundary: Trace the authenticated Maths home response and frontend equivalent-card normalisation for the specific account/session showing Lessons; do not mutate L3T2M24 video/catalogue state unless new evidence directly implicates it.
